criteria.criterion: ccmorph run -i, ccmorph config and ccmorph inspect on a closed or piped stdin (no tty) exit with a named cause ("needs a terminal") and a non-zero status; none waits forever, and run -i does not print Cancelled and then hang.
criteria.evidence: cli/ui.go (uiTheme.search, fix commit f883a68, the same patch as 631f726) asks /dev/tty itself before launching fzf: where a terminal answers, the picker runs untouched and unbounded; where none does, the caller's own picker command runs once under pickerNoTerminalBound (5 s, `_CCMORPH_PICKER_BOUND` seam) with captured streams, an answering fake still chooses, Esc (130) still cancels, and anything else is refused by name ('ccmorph: selection needs a terminal; pass the value directly', rc 2). Regression run on this branch 2026-11-21: `CCMORPH_TEST_FILTER=test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725 zsh tests/ccmorph_test.zsh` -> `PASS: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725`, `All 1 tests passed`. The test drives run -i, config, inspect and inspect -i under </dev/null, detached into their own session so no controlling terminal exists, inside a 20 s bound, asserting each exits non-zero, prints `needs a terminal`, and prints no `Cancelled`. Go side: `go test ./cli/ -run TestSearchPickerWithoutTerminal -count=1 -v` -> 5 subtests PASS and `ok github.com/akleizor/ccmorph/cli 0.259s`, with the fake fzf pinned first on PATH, its invocation marker asserted, and the exact refusal text and rc checked; the waiting-picker case is stopped by the bound seam in 200 ms. Full launch suite on the gate: `All 84 tests passed`.

criteria.criterion: One shared no-tty guard covers the pickers behind all three verbs (not one check per entry point).
criteria.evidence: The guard (ttyUsable + runPickerAnswerOnly + refuseNoTerminal) lives in uiTheme.search in cli/ui.go, the search picker every profile picker walks through: `grep -n 'uiSelect("search"' cli/menus.go` prints `109: v, rc := uiSelect("search", "Profile", strings.Join(rows, "\n"), "all")` and `189: return uiSelect("search", prompt, rows, display)`, and uiSelect dispatches to t.search. `grep -rn 'exec.Command(fzf' --include=*.go . | grep -v _test.go` prints only `./cli/ui.go:911: cmd := exec.Command(fzf, args...)`; `grep -rn fzf lib/ | wc -l` is 0, so the shell layer starts no picker of its own. The zsh regression exercises run -i, config, inspect and inspect -i through that one function.

criteria.criterion: A zsh-suite regression test runs each verb under </dev/null inside a timeout: it fails on today's main (hang) and passes after; interactive picker behaviour with a tty is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Fails on main, passes after. Main reproduction 2026-11-21: a `git clone --no-hardlinks` of this branch (c1f0b56) into $TMPDIR, `git checkout origin/main -- cli/ui.go` (main 152b082), `make shim`, then `CCMORPH_TEST_FILTER=test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725 zsh tests/ccmorph_test.zsh` printed `ccmorph run -i with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, `ccmorph config with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, `ccmorph inspect with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, `ccmorph inspect -i with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, then `FAIL: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725`, `1 of 1 tests failed`. The same command on this branch prints PASS (see criterion 1). Interactive unchanged: the tty branch of uiTheme.search is the pre-issue launch untouched (`cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr; out, err = cmd.Output()`, no clock), entered whenever stdin is a tty or /dev/tty opens, so a foreground person's picker and piped stdin on a terminal behave as before; the full gate's launch suite `All 84 tests passed` includes test_model_command_sets_the_profiles_default_model, test_set_model_interactively_saves_the_chosen_id, test_set_effort_interactively_offers_the_engine_levels, test_search_picker_on_an_old_fzf_never_hides_rows_silently_issue_278 and test_the_picker_without_fzf_names_the_direct_command_and_the_choices, and `go test ./...` is green (see criterion 4 and Checks not run). A pty-backed person-path test is not runnable in this sandbox (no ptys); that path is the unchanged pre-issue code.

criteria.criterion: Every Go file on this branch is gofmt-clean: CI's own check `gofmt -l .` prints nothing (the step that refused PR #772 on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-latest), and CI's next step's vet and build, `go vet ./... && go build ./...`, pass on this branch for linux and for GOOS=darwin, with `go test ./cli/` ok.
criteria.evidence: The CI failure of run 44914397230 (PR #772) was exactly `these files are not gofmt-clean: cli/ui_test.go`, and every later step of that job was skipped. Fixed in commit 679bca1 ('test(picker): gofmt the #725 picker test table'), whitespace only: `git diff --numstat` was `2 2 cli/ui_test.go` and `git diff -w --exit-code` exited 0; the only change is one space after `name:` and `body:` in the `refuses a picker that waits past the bound` case. After it, on this branch 2026-11-21: `gofmt -l .` prints nothing; `go vet ./... && go build ./...` ok; `GOOS=darwin go vet ./... && GOOS=darwin go build ./...` ok; `go test ./cli/ -count=1` -> `ok github.com/akleizor/ccmorph/cli 10.106s`. The full gate ran `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` and `umask 077 && go test -count=1 ./...` with 0 Go failures (`grep -cE '^(FAIL|--- FAIL)([[:space:]]|$)' .hive/gate3.log` = 0, 25 `ok` package lines, util included).
